android.desc:
No bank login. No cloud sync. Your data never leaves your device.

WealthYogi is a privacy-first net worth tracker and financial independence (FIRE) planner — built for people who want real financial-planning tools without handing their bank credentials to another budgeting app.

WHY WEALTHYOGI
• No bank linking, no Plaid, no OAuth tokens — you type your own balances
• Everything stays on your device — no account, no cloud storage, no ads
• 23+ currencies for tracking global assets

FINANCIAL HEALTH SCORE
A Vitality Score across 10+ indicators used by financial advisors — Liquidity, Debt-to-Asset ratio, Cash Runway, and more — so you know exactly where you stand, not just your net worth number.

FIRE PROJECTIONS
Plan financial independence and early retirement with Monte Carlo success-probability simulations and named scenarios, so you can compare different retirement ages and savings rates side by side.

DEBT PAYOFF PLANNER
Avalanche vs. snowball payoff strategies, with a full month-by-month payment schedule — see exactly when each debt clears under either approach.

SAVINGS GOALS
Set a target, see a month-by-month projection of when you'll get there — with an optional link to real accounts so progress updates itself.

PORTFOLIO ALLOCATION
Set target allocations across your assets and get drift alerts when your actual mix moves away from plan.

Update your balances, check your score, steer your plan — a net worth tracker and FIRE calculator built around one rule: your financial data never leaves your device. Verified in our Play Data Safety disclosure — no data collected.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone 
I’ve been on my FIRE journey for a while and got tired of juggling spreadsheets, brokers, and bank apps — so I built WealthYogi, a privacy-first net worth tracker focused on clarity and peace of mind.
 Why
Like many FIRE folks, I was juggling spreadsheets, bank apps, and broker dashboards — but never had one clear, connected view of my true net worth.
Most apps required logins or shared data with third parties — not ideal if you care about privacy.
So I built WealthYogi to be:
 Offline-first & private — all data stays 100% on your device
 Simple — focus purely on your wealth trajectory, not budgeting noise
 Multi-currency — 23 currencies, supporting GBP, USD, EUR, INR and more 
 What it does now
* Tracks your net worth and portfolio value in real time
* Categorises assets (liquid, semi-liquid, illiquid) and liabilities (loans, mortgages, etc.)
* Multi-currency support (GBP, USD, EUR, INR and more)
* Privacy-first: all data stays 100% on your device
* 10+ Financial Health Indicators and Personalised Finance Health Score and Suggestions to improve 
* Minimal, distraction-free design focused purely on your wealth trajectory

 Real-time account sync

quotes.text:
I built WealthYogi for iOS and Android around a simple idea:

*Personal finance is not just about tracking money. It's about building better habits and changing how we behave with money.*

The app is built around a simple loop:

*Track → Know → Control → Repeat*

*Track*
Track your financial accounts globally, with support for 23 currencies, live FX rates, and 18 different account types.

*Know*
WealthYogi uses 10+ personal-finance metrics to help you understand your financial health — not just your net worth. It highlights what needs attention and what you're already doing well.

*Control*
Based on that guidance, you can set financial goals and track your progress. The idea is to turn financial insights into concrete actions and, over time, better habits.

*Repeat*
Review your financial health, work on the areas that need attention, track your goals, and repeat.

The goal here is to help answer:

*Where am I financially? What should I focus on? And am I actually getting better?*

I'd really like people to try it and tell me honestly:

*Does this actually help you build right money habits and change how you manage your money?*

Feedback, criticism, and especially disagreement with the product idea are very welcome.

If you'd rather share private feedback, you can reach me at hello@datayogi.io.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/wealthyogi-net-worth-fire/id6753881658

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dyogi.wealthtracker.android
